t.t: Anabtawi Invest | Diversified Companies, Unified Vision

div.p:
From the authenticity of fine food to future-facing enterprise.
A diversified business group uniting heritage, excellence, and forward growth.

div.aria-label: Group companies in food, agriculture, and tech

div.p: THE GROUP / ABOUT US
div.h2:
Diversity in Enterprise.
Integrity in Vision.

div.p: Anabtawi Invest brings together a resilient portfolio of companies across food industries, commercial trading, agriculture, and enterprise solutions. Each company carries its distinct expertise and heritage, united by a shared vision of quality and ambition.
From traditional Arab sweets, pure honey, and artisanal cheeses, to livestock, Arabian horses, and enterprise ERP systems; our diversity reflects the growing footprint of our group.
PORTFOLIO / SUBSIDIARIES

Distinct brand identities, synergistic value.
Discover the companies that define our group.
